subject: QEMU_CONTROL_REFERENCE

sut.environment: WSL2 with stock QEMU 11.0.2 q35/qtest, pcie-root-port at 00:02.0 and virtio-net-pci,aer=on endpoint at 01:00.0 (Requester ID 0x0100)

components.name: QEMU hw/pci/pcie_aer.c
components.version: v11.0.2 source tree used for the build

hypotheses: A first routed Correctable message sets Root COR_RCV and the Correctable Source; another routed Correctable message before Root Status clear sets MULTI_COR_RCV.
Endpoint CES/CED W1C and Root Correctable Status W1C are independent observable operations.
Distinct Correctable bits OR into Endpoint CES while uncleared, and the second routed message sets Root MULTI_COR_RCV.
After Endpoint CES/CED and Root Correctable Status are independently cleared and read back zero, a new Correctable injection re-arms first-message behavior.

observations.name: first-multiple
observations.result: First B0 produced Endpoint CES=0x00000001, Device Status.CED=1, Root Status=0x00000001 and Source=0x0100. Repeating B0 without clear retained CES=0x00000001 and changed Root Status to 0x00000003.

observations.name: independent-w1c
observations.result: Clearing only Endpoint CES/CED left Root Status=0x00000001. After rebuilding the state, clearing only Root Correctable Status left Endpoint CES=0x00000001 and CED=1.

observations.name: bit-or
observations.result: B0 followed by B1 without clear produced Endpoint CES=0x00000041, Root Status=0x00000003 and Source=0x0100.

observations.name: rearm
observations.result: CES-only W1C left CED and Root reception set; CED-only W1C then cleared the Endpoint Device Status independently; Root W1C cleared Root Status; reinjection produced the first-message state again with Root Status=0x00000001 rather than MULTI_COR_RCV.

observations.name: root-source-after-w1c
observations.result: QEMU retained Correctable Source=0x0100 after Root Status W1C. The oracle therefore constrains Root Status independence but deliberately does not require Root Source to clear.

observations.name: safety
observations.result: Across all 12 fresh-process cases, Endpoint and Root Uncorrectable Status stayed zero, Root Uncorrectable reception/source stayed zero, Root Device Status stayed clean, and Endpoint Device Status contained no error bit other than CED.

limitations: This is a QEMU control reference, not VMware behavior and not a Qman product implementation result.
The runner injects virtual Correctable status through QEMU HMP; it does not reproduce an electrical PCIe link fault or physical device internal recovery.

Root Error Command was enabled for the canonical sequence matrix. The earlier eight-gate matrix separately tests g100/g101 Root deposition equivalence but neither run attributes an MSI, MSI-X or INTx notification.
Root Source retention after W1C is an observation of this exact QEMU version and topology, not a universal PCIe or ESXi rule.
No ESXi owner, VM lifecycle, guest write filter, host log/service path, reset, health, quarantine, or safe tenant reuse behavior is proven by this evidence.
VMW-AER-COR-001, M26, M06, TS-F4-06 and R13 therefore remain partial or open until their independently scoped ESXi and Qman evidence gates are satisfied.
